The surname '''al'Vere''' may refer to the following people:

*[[Egwene al'Vere]] - originally a [[Wisdom]] apprentice, now [[Amyrlin Seat]] of the [[White Tower]].
*[[Brandelwyn al'Vere]] - [[Mayor]] of [[Emond's Field]] and owner of the [[Winespring Inn]] and father of Egwene.
*[[Marin al'Vere]] - cook at the Winespring Inn, arguably one of the best in Emond's Field, and mother of Egwene.
*[[Loise al'Vere]] - a resident of Emond's Field and older sister of Egwene.
*[[Elisa al'Vere]] - a resident of Emond's Field and older sister of Egwene.
*[[Alene al'Vere]] - a resident of Emond's Field and older sister of Egwene.
*[[Berowyn al'Vere]] - the eldest of the al'Vere children, with a husband and infant deceased from [[breakbone fever]].
